The report is circulated to members and debenture holders electronically and available on the company website.

filing.subject: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 38,222 equity shares of face value ₹10/- each in Creative Port Development Private Limited ( CPDPL ) due to conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares of CPDPL, as per terms of issue
filing.nse_summary: Tata Steel Limited acquired 38,222 equity shares in Creative Port Development Private Limited on November 7, 2026. This acquisition resulted from the conversion of 25,10,830 Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. The conversion ratio was one equity share for every 65.69 preference shares. Tata Steel’s equity stake in the subsidiary increased from 51% to 57.5%. The company received a cash payment of ₹6,876.11 for fractional entitlements. Creative Port Development Private Limited remains a subsidiary of Tata Steel. The target entity operates in the transportation and storage sector. No governmental or regulatory approvals were required for this transaction.

filing.subject: Max Healthcare Institute Limited has informed the Exchange about transcript of Earnings Call held on November 3, 2026
filing.nse_summary: Max Healthcare Institute Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call held on November 3, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a 20% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 3,219 crore and an 18% increase in operating EBITDA to INR 820 crore for the second quarter. Profit after tax rose 10% to INR 448 crore. Average network occupancy remained steady at 77% despite a 14% increase in bed capacity. The Board approved an investment of INR 415 crore for adding 209 brownfield beds at Max Noida, Max Vaishali, and BLK-Max, along with a car park tower at BLK. Shareholding in Kalinga Hospital Limited increased to 66%. The transcript is available on the company website.

filing.subject: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
filing.nse_summary: Zydus Lifesciences Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 post results earnings call held on November 4, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenues of ₹79.1 billion, up 29% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at ₹18.9 billion with a margin of 24%. Net profit was ₹9.3 billion. The net debt to EBITDA ratio was 0.62 times as on September 30, 2026. India branded formulations grew 19% year-on-year. International markets formulations revenues were ₹10 billion, up 33% year-on-year. US revenues reached ₹33.1 billion, up 21% year-on-year. Consumer wellness revenues were ₹11.2 billion, up 76% year-on-year. Medical devices revenues were ₹2.2 billion. The company received USFDA acceptance for the BLA for a Keytruda biosimilar. Phase IIb trial results for Saroglitazar in MASH were positive. The company is investing in the US launch of Saroglitazar.

Communication To Shareholders - Intimation Of Tax Deduction At Source (TDS)
filing.nse_summary: Premier Energies Limited approved an interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The board meeting was held on November 4th, 2026. The record date for eligibility is Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Dividends will be paid electronically to shareholders with updated bank mandates in their demat accounts. The company will deduct tax at source under the Income-tax Act, 2025, as amended by the Finance Act, 2026. Tax rates vary based on shareholder category and residential status. Resident individuals receiving up to Rs. 10,000 in total dividends for the financial year 2026-27 are exempt from tax deduction. Shareholders must update their Permanent Account Number and residential status with the registrar or depository participants. Documents for lower or no tax deduction must be submitted to the registrar by November 11, 2026. Failure to provide valid documentation may result in higher tax deduction rates.
